name: Shopify
description: Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform that lets businesses build an online store, process payments, and sell across web, mobile, social, and in-person channels.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Monthly equivalent with annual billing, not the annual total. $39/mo if billed monthly instead. Shopify lists a 2% third-party payment-provider transaction fee on this plan; that fee is separate from the provider’s own processing charge.

tiers.name: Grow
tiers.notes: Monthly equivalent with annual billing, not the annual total. Shopify lists a 1% third-party payment-provider transaction fee on this plan; that fee is separate from the provider’s own processing charge. Up to 5 staff accounts.

tiers.name: Advanced
tiers.notes: Monthly equivalent with annual billing, not the annual total. Shopify lists a 0.6% third-party payment-provider transaction fee on this plan; that fee is separate from the provider’s own processing charge. Up to 15 staff accounts.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Starting price ('from'), for complex/high-volume businesses — likely negotiated above this for most merchants.

best_for: Positioned for businesses of all sizes — from solo entrepreneurs launching their first store to large enterprises.
features: Website builder with themes and AI-assisted design

alternatives.name: BigCommerce
alternatives.description: An ecommerce platform supporting both B2C and B2B storefronts, marketplaces, and social commerce channels.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses needing B2B account/pricing workflows alongside a standard storefront.

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce platform built as a WordPress plugin, giving merchants full control over their store.
alternatives.best_for: WordPress users/developers wanting full customization ownership.
